features: High Resolution Imaging: The digital camera captures up to 64MP photos and records 4K video, delivering ultra clear images with rich details and precise color reproduction. It also supports 16x digital zoom.
Vibrant Display Screen: Equipped with a 2.8 inch ultra HD screen, the sliding digital camera offers a vivid color display, helping you find the ideal filming angle with ease.

Advanced Focus and Lighting: Featuring AF auto focus, the camera compensates for shaky hands, allowing for one click filming. It includes a bright fill light and supports portrait beauty, filter adjustments, and time lapse.
Stylish Retro Design: This camera boasts an elegant retro sliding cover design, combining beauty with practicality. Made from premium ABS material, it is sturdy, wear proof, and reliable to use.
Ample Battery Life: Powered by a high capacity 700mAh battery, the digital camera provides sufficient power for various applications, including travel, gatherings, graduation, and documenting growth.
